question: The volume of a right circular cone is 1078 cm³. Find the total surface area of the cone if its height is 21 cm. (Use π = 22/7)
solution:
**Given:**

Volume of a cone = 1078 cm³

Height of the cone = 21 cm

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cone, V = (1/3) × π × r² × h

Slant height, l = √(r² + h²)

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a cone = π × r × (r + l)

**Calculation:**

From the volume formula:

Volume, V = (1/3) × π × r² × h

⇒ 1078 = (1/3) × (22/7) × r² × 21

⇒ 1078 = (22/7) × r² × 7

⇒ 1078 = 22 × r²

⇒ r² = 1078 / 22

⇒ r² = 49

⇒ r = √49

⇒ r = 7 cm

Now, calculate the slant height (l):

l = √(r² + h²)

⇒ l = √(7² + 21²)

⇒ l = √(49 + 441)

⇒ l = √490

⇒ l = 7√10

Now, calculate the Total Surface Area (TSA):

TSA = π × r × (r + l)

⇒ TSA = (22/7) × 7 × (7 + 7√10)

⇒ TSA = 22 × (7 + 7√10)

⇒ TSA = 154 × (1 + √10) cm²

The Total Surface Area of the cone is 154(1 + √10) cm².
